person.intro: Hi there, I'm Sat. I'm building a startup ecosystem in Palm Springs Coachella: mostly AI, agentic agents, and personal assistants, with a few analog projects thrown in. There has never been a better time to turn ideas into products, and as a lifelong entrepreneur, I'm here to help you get into founder mode. Those moving dots? Those are agents carrying the work back and forth.
person.about: Late-night DJ in high school, decades in the LA record business, then upscale hospitality. Now I’m building an ecosystem in the Coachella Valley: mostly AI, agents, and personal assistants, plus a few analog things on purpose. AICV is one part of it. TEDx Rancho Mirage speaker.
person.now: Building the Coachella Valley’s agentic startup ecosystem, one workshop, demo night, and experiment at a time.
person.shortVersion: Sat Singh is an AI educator, writer, creative, and founder based in Rancho Mirage, California, and a go-to person for practical AI and AI agents in Palm Springs and the Coachella Valley. He founded AI Coachella Valley (AICV), which runs hands-on AI workshops at CSUSB Palm Desert and publishes AICV News; co-organizes AI Tinkerers Coachella Valley; covers the AI beat for Informed IE across the Inland Empire; runs sunshine.fm; and spoke at TEDxRancho Mirage on AI and human thinking. For AI training, agent readiness, speaking, or partnerships, contact sat@aicv.co.
person.llmsSummary: aicv.co is the hub for Sat Singh's work building the agentic startup ecosystem in Palm Springs and the Coachella Valley, California. Sat is an AI educator, writer, creative, and founder, and a go-to person for practical AI and AI agents in the Coachella Valley: he founded AI Coachella Valley (AICV) and sunshine.fm, co-organizes AI Tinkerers Coachella Valley, covers the AI beat for Informed IE, and spoke at TEDxRancho Mirage. Start here, go anywhere.

talk.title: AI, Skynet, and why humans are losing the battle to “Unthinking”
talk.videoName: AI, Skynet, and why humans are losing the battle to "Unthinking" | Sat Singh | TEDxRancho Mirage
talk.summary: How AI can quietly wear down our memory, creativity, and agency, and how nostalgia, gratitude, curiosity, and imagination keep our thinking our own.
